title: Pull-back form of currentEval for one blow-up: currentEval(η_{x,λ#}T, ω) = currentEval(T, η^#ω)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary subset, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), x ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0. Write η := η_{x,λ} = dilation x λ, η(p) = −λ⁻¹x + λ⁻¹p = λ⁻¹(p − x), and η_{x,λ#}T := blowUp T x λ ∈ 𝒟_n(η(U)). For an n-form ω on ℝ^P let η^#ω := affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P λ) (−(λ⁻¹•x)) ω, i.e. (η^#ω)(p)(v₁, …, vₙ) = ω(η(p))(λ⁻¹v₁, …, λ⁻¹vₙ). For a current A with domain V and an n-form β let currentEval(A, β) := A(β) if β is a test form (C^∞ with compact support) with tsupport β ⊆ V, and 0 otherwise. Then currentEval(η_{x,λ#}T, ω) = currentEval(T, η^#ω) for every n-form ω on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n), currentEval (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ω = currentEval T (affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P lam) (-(lam⁻¹ • x)) ω)
